recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: tabletop moss gardens and bottled microforests trending
terminal UIs creeping back onto everyday screens
spring fog and seventeen degrees wrapping the shoreline
overnight sculpture appearing where pedestrians pause
stutter beats and synth pads threading through earbuds

composer-2-fast.concept: On-beat pulses expand glowing rings across a planter bed; misses let weeds snap the rhythm chain.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: each clean phrase visibly grows another ring of seedlings
composer-2-fast.escalation: ghost echoes and BPM drift muddy the waveform
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon stems on charcoal soil, house-club vignette

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Trace dew paths between bonsai nodes before coastal wind evaporates the thread.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw a path connecting nodes within a time meter
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: linked nodes bloom with a watercolor burst
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: crosswinds shorten the dew timer and erase partial lines
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: soft fog gray and moss green watercolor

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Flick phosphor glyphs into the correct CRT pipeline before the shell buffer scrolls.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: sort and flick symbols into lanes
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: clean compile clears noise lines with satisfying hum
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: pseudo-random color tags swap meaning every few seconds

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick biodegradable seed pellets up a vertical living wall physics tower before shade bands advance.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: angled flick with weak gravity arcs
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: sticky hits leave visible sprouts that rack combo height
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: rolling shadow slabs narrow the usable wall
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: matte planter panels and pastel afternoon light
